name: same-tabs
title: Same tabs, straighter paths (the control)
summary: Keeps Library, Following and Margins exactly where they are and changes only paths: the eight shared fixes, plus Following folds a noisy show to one row with a Quiet option, Manage feeds keeps following and importing but gets a Paste button and opens the file picker at once. This is the least structural proposal. It is here to show how much of the tap-count gain comes from path fixes alone, so the structural proposals are judged on what they add beyond it: guessability, screen count and the noisy show.
shared_fixes: Margins list newest first; a Margin row plays its moment and a chevron opens its details.
Margin details offer Share this Margin (a one-Margin packet to the share sheet).
Item details show the published date and the date added.
Export all Margins is one toolbar button on the Margins tab that hands a Markdown bundle to the share sheet; the folder export moves under Settings.
Settings is one tap from every tab (gear). The Library's options menu is removed; Help lives in Settings.
Clear reproducible audio is a button on Settings itself; Offline Storage keeps the detail.
Unfollow is a context-menu action with an Undo toast instead of a confirmation alert.
Settings sections: Voice, Storage, Notes folder, Import & export (collapsed to two rows), Help, About & legal (collapsed).
